However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid.

3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Sr.DFM/NANDED payable at NANDED . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Sr.DFM/NANDED . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Sr.DFM/NANDED payable at NANDED . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr.DFM/NANDED A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Special conditions of contract (other than SLA) 1. Role and criteria of Resources hired (TADK) a) Hired manpower should be multi-skilled and competent for multi-tasking. The y will be attached to servi ng designated officers at their residence / office for multitasking jobs assigned by officer to them. b) Hired manpower should have attained 18 years as of the date of engagement . c) Hired resources should be fluent in the language spoken by the concerned officer and his family, whom he will be attached with. d) Hired resources must possess Aadhar and be free from any criminal antecedent. e) Hired resources should possess multi-tasking skills for discharge of duty at the residence/office of the off icer concerned. f) Hired resources should not be suffering from any contagious diseases and an y medical history must be brought to the notice of the concerned officer at the ti me of suitability. g) Hired resources must stay/reside at nearby locations so that in urgency they can attend to their duty pr omptly. The Concerned officer (for whom he is hired) may also allow him to reside in the outhouse of their residence. h) Hired resource must carry out the duty with full diligence, care, and sincerity and should be obedient an d honest. 1) The attendant engaged by the Agency shall not take part in any Railway staff union or association activi ties. k) Hired Resources may have to accompany the Concerned Officer in Field work / Official Visits, Inspection s etc. included anywhere in the country, in addition to assigned duty at Residence of Officer and NO extra payment shall be made regarding this. 2. Role of Service Provider: In addition to clause 4 of SLA which specifies the role of Service provider fol lowing are the additional Roles of Service provider. (a) Agency shall deploy the resources i.e. Attendant within 7 days of issue of Letter of Acceptance. (b) Prior to such engagement of TADK (Hired Human resource), the suitability of the Attendant shall be ass essed and certified by the Officer for whom outsource d person is being provided. Detailed Bio-data of the Attendant in Standard form at giving full whereabouts with details like, Name in Capital letters, Name of P arents and siblings, Date of Birth, Educational Qualification, Previous experience, Character Certificate, Cas te certificate, Religion, Current and Permanent Residential Address. Blood Group, photograph, Mobile No. p ro of of IDs like Aadhaar, PAN Card, Driving License , Voter Card, Ration Card etc. copy of the ID proof to be submitted to Consignee. (c) The antecedents of attendant to be deployed shall be verified by the service provider from local police authority and undertaking in this regard is to be submitted to the Consignee. (d) Service provider shall produce physical and mental fitness certificate from doctor of any Govt Hospital for man power resources hired through contract. (e) There shall be no unilateral change of the Attendant by the Contracted agency. If at all any such chang e or alternate Attendant is proposed, it should be onl y as per suitability and with the approval of Officer concerned duly intimating the same to the contract awarding authority. (f) In case of absence of assigned attendant, the contracted agency should prov ide an alternate Attendan t as replacement on regular or temporary account, the alternate resource, shall also fulfil all the criteria as applicable for the regular T ADK viz. Police verification, Character certificate, ID Cards, Language abilities,

medical category etc. and detailed bio-data of the same along with proof of IDs shall be submitted. (g) In case of any resource permanently leaving the organization or taking leave for a longer duration, service provider shall communicate the same to buyer at l east 1 month prior to the last working day of a r esource. Suitable substitute(s) s hall be provided by Service Provider as per mutual understanding with bu yer. (h) Payment to the attendant shall be made on or before 7th of the following month based on the attenda nce sheet certified by the officer concerned. (i) The Service Provider shall be responsible for any act of indiscipline on the part of the persons deployed. (j) Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws: Compliance of labour laws, Payment of Minimum Wages Act, Work man's Compensation Act, EPF/ESI provisions, Shramik Kalyan provisions and any such statutory provisions vis-a vis the employee would be the responsibility of the bidder/contractor and the Contractor shall submit a certificate of the compliance thereof to Consignee. The invoice for a particular month must be accompani ed by the documentary proof towards the above for the previous month. (k) Liability for deployed personnel All persons deployed, in ensuring services with Railways, by the bidder shall be engaged by them as their own employees/workers in all respects and the responsibility under any statutory enactments in respect of all such personnel shall be that of the bidder. The bidder shall indemnif y Railways, against all claims whatsoever arising in respect of the said personnel under any statute/law in f orce. 3. Role of the concerned officer and Consignee: The Concerned officer shall be responsible to mainta in the attendance in the attendance sheet/ register an d shall send the attendance to the Personnel branch for compiling bills. The Attendance should be submitted on 1st day of every month. If the 1st day of the m onth happens to be a holiday, then it should be submitted on the next working day. (a) Concerned officer shall provide suitability of hired resources for him/her to t he Personnel branch befor e engaging their service. b) The concerned officer shall make necessary arrangements for use of basic facilities like water pots, was hrooms etc. for manpower working at his premise/ designated premise. c) Consignee in the contract shall be Personnel branch officer of the unit. He shall monitor the contract an d its performance and ensure bill payment on time. 4. Payment Terms: Payment cycle shall be monthly and should be as per GTC of GeM. consideration will be paid by Railways to the bidder against monthly invoices raised on completion of each month for the ser vices provided, by the bidder. Such payments shall be made within fifteen days of/ on the receipt of the said invoices along with required documents in duplicate. TDS will be deducted as per prevailing rates. Th e consideration is all inclusive and no other amounts will be payable to the bidder by Railways on any accou nt whatsoever, unless otherwise specifically agreed to in writing. The tax invoice will be supported by the following documents: 1. Salary sheet for the month with details of allowances & recoveries 2. EPF challenges 3. ESI challans 4. Bank Statement as proof of payment to employees 5. Certificate pertaining to/regarding compliance of Shramik Kalyan portal 6. Copy of Attendance certified by the concerned Officer/s under whom they are working 7. Any other documents, if required 5. Penalty Clause: Penalties will be applicable as per Clause 5 of GeM Service Legal Agreement (SLA). Ho wever, Buyer reserves the right to cancel the contract in case of repeated breach on request of the Person nel branch C.
